gaps.why_now: The shared Phase 11 build entry now keeps the existing gpio_wdt lane, the bcm2835_wdt starter tests, and the bcm2835 survey checkpoint reviewable together so the watchdog tranche does not drift across simple-driver anchors.

A dedicated survey gate still matters after the starter lands and master advances because it keeps the validation matrix status plus the remaining bcm2835_wdt gap explicit instead of letting the now-established scaffold imply platform or hardware parity that has not been implemented.

The survey note now records the current master head where the bcm2835_wdt starter, watchdog metadata summary, probe-time bookkeeping helper, registration summary, platform handoff summary, poweroff-path summary, and remove-time teardown summary are already landed while live platform registration, PM base wiring, and live poweroff-handler coordination remain out of scope.

The bounded starter now covers watchdog metadata, timeout tick encoding, running-bit detection, start and stop register transitions, restart intent, halt-partition bookkeeping, a tiny probe summary, a registration-facing handoff or poweroff ownership summary, a platform-registration and PM-base handoff summary, a poweroff-path summary, and a remove-time teardown summary without claiming platform-backed behavior.
